messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 SLO alert: p99 latency > 1.5s for /v1/stream (eu-central) — realtime-detector
ana: @oncall paging — p99 spike in streaming, customers seeing stalls. Pulling up dashboards.
jason: I got the page, joining. Anyone on recent deploys to eu cluster? priya?
priya: No deploys in last 60m. Grafana shows p95 up ~200ms, p99 up ~1.6s. Tail spikes concentrated on eu-gpu-3..6. KV cache hit rate dropped ~20%.
mike: Could be prefix cache thrash or redis flapping. Can someone check kvcache evictions + redis errors?
priya: Quick check logs now:
```
kubectl logs -n inference eu-gpu-5 | grep -i "kvcache eviction"
# multiple eviction bursts aligning with p99 windows
```
ana: Customer impact: Support dashboard shows acme-inc experiencing increased errors (0.8% vs baseline 0.02%). Not global but user-visible for that tenant.
jason: Ok. Quick mitigations: 1) shift traffic off affected eu nodes -> us-west canary 2) enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant for streaming 3) reduce worker batch sizes. Who can run the route shift?
mike: I can drive the batch-size change. Jason, you run route-shift?
jason: Running route-shift (canary 30%) now. Command I used:
```
redwood route shift --from eu-central --to us-west --routes /v1/stream --percent 30
```
mike: Applying batch-size patch now:
```
kubectl patch deployment stream-workers -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH","value":"8"}]}]}}}}'
```
priya: After 10m post-shift: p99 dropped from ~1.6s -> ~0.9s, stalls reduced. KV eviction rate still elevated but tail impact lower.
ana: Support notified customers. @support-bot please open priority ticket and start comms.
support-bot: Ticket INC-7892 created, assigned to Support-SRE. Email template for impacted accounts queued.
jason: Good containment. Next actions: priya gather traces + kvcache histograms for the window, mike to run deeper redis/network checks, ana to own customer follow-up. We'll keep monitoring and escalate if p99 climbs again. :thumbsup:
